svg.title: One PR description before and after the #421 work
svg.desc: Visible text of two real descriptions, abbreviated. Before: #543, merged 2026-10-15. It has a summary, a checkpoint status saying ready for review with no open findings, links to the walkthrough and checkpoint, and a free-form Area and Result table with rows for rebased commits, evidence, local tests and full validation. Provenance, skills, usage and cost of $9.85, settings and WIP details are collapsed. Not on the page: the problem, what was left out, how closely to review, and what went unproven. After: #974, merged 2026-10-29. It has a recommendation of Merge with links to the walkthrough, code review and checkpoint, a summary, and an Intent block. Intent, added by #553, gives Why, a Task line added by #885, a Root cause line added by #633, Safe because, Review effort 2 of 5 with floor 2 from pr_watch.rb added by #757, and Scope with size, ordered by #888. Verification opens with a validation and review line Shaka writes, added by #740, then a Setup gaps line saying 1 of 2 configured reviewers completed, added by #923. The checks and Not verified line are folded under Evidence and limitations, added by #810. Shaka metrics are collapsed. A note says the Setup gaps line was wrong here: both reviewers ran, and the agent passed Shaka one result file, as #984 later found. Tags name Tan as the source for Intent, and Osmani as the source for the review floor and validation line, by the orchestrating session's account.
svg.text: One PR description, before and after the #421 work
Visible text, abbreviated. Tags: the PR and, on three, the source (see Attribution).
Before: #543, merged 2026-10-15
Every commit SHA in a local review comment now links to GitHub,
including commits reviewed before a rebase and never pushed.
Checkpoint
Status: Ready for review; local review loop closed with no
open findings.
Code Walkthrough · Checkpoint
Area
Result
Rebased commits
Matched by subject, author date, and exact change
Evidence
On #539, all 7 rebased-away commits resolved
Local tests
Local review suites: 380 runs, 0 failures
Full validation
Hosted validate, CodeQL, and claude-review pass
▸ Provenance · skills · usage and cost $9.85 · settings · WIP
Not on the page: the problem, what was left out, how closely
to review, and what went unproven.
After: #974, merged 2026-10-29
Recommendation: Merge · Code Walkthrough · Code Review · Checkpoint
Summary
A PR merged with GitHub's merge button now shows its merge
time in Timings.
Intent
Why: Under Ask, nothing republished the description after a
GitHub merge click, so its merge time stayed pending.
Task: GitHub · fixes #963
Root cause: Only shaka description wrote the merge time.
Safe because: The write reuses the ready-time path.
Review effort: 2 of 5. Floor 2: changes code (pr_watch.rb)
#757 · Osmani
Scope: pr watch records the merge time. (5 files, +86 / −6)
Verification
Validation and review: validate passed (exit 0); local
#740 · Osmani
review by openai/codex at 570d2ad.
Setup gaps: 1 of 2 configured reviewers completed;
anthropic did not.
▸ Evidence and limitations: three checks and Not verified
▸ Shaka metrics: usage and cost $6.20 · timings · settings
Setup gaps was wrong here: both reviewers ran, and the agent
passed Shaka one result file (found later, in #984).
